entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Only one more week[n]until the elections!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: People are treating this like[n]some kind of massive party. It[n]does not feel like an election.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The candidates who were running[n]against Shido have completely[n]given up as well.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's fine. His reign ain't[n]gonna last much longer.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We'll make him apologize[n]to every last citizen.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Everyone will definitely snap[n]out of it if we can do that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: First and foremost, we should[n]focus on changing his heart.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I hope you understand, [fName].[n]We don't have time to waste.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Don't worry! You have all[n]of us backing you up!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Still, we may be cutting[n]this a little too close.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There's no reason to be[n]waffling on this anymore.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We just gotta do it![n]Time to make up your mind.
